spec_basis.STU-COL-177: Swatches organise into named groups. Exactly one ROOT group exists per palette and is not deletable. A swatch belongs to at most one group. Group operations: create, rename, delete (with a replace-on-delete target), reorder, and move-between-groups.
spec_basis.STU-COL-178: Three scopes: document, application, system ... a system palette reflects the OS palette and is read-only. A swatch reference resolves in document -> application -> system order and an unresolvable reference is a validation error, never a silent black.
spec_basis.STU-COL-185: A branded book is a DATA ADAPTER that populates native spot swatches ... the displayed swatch name is name_prefix + name + name_postfix
spec_basis.STU-COL-186: license_state (bundled | operator_supplied | absent) and license_note ... MUST NOT bundle a book whose rights holder does not permit redistribution ... an absent book loses only the ability to LOOK UP
spec_basis.STU-COL-187: five bundled families, PANTONE not bundled; NOT a Studio bundling instruction
spec_basis.STU-COL-188: a book supplied as an ICC named-colour profile (ncl2) is bound through STU-COL-126, not a bespoke parser
spec_basis.source: Master Spec v02.229 14-studio-creative-suite.md :10605-10619, :10662-10693; STU-COL-103 counts :9918-9928; STU-COL-126 :10256

notes.icc_crate_finding: hsk-studio-prism is the crate that parses ICC profiles and their tags: moxcms 0.9.1 parses (header incl. ProfileClass::Named, but it ignores unknown tags such as ncl2), Prism's own wide.rs frame() reads the raw tag table (sig, type, offset, size) and icc_eval.rs interprets curv/para/mft1/mft2/mAB/mBA. No crate parsed ncl2 at base (WIDE_DESCRIPTOR lists named-colour profiles as not_in_scope; admit() refuses nmcl). Added prism src/named_colour.rs reusing wide::verify + wide::frame.
notes.ncl2_encoding_evidence: Field order and sizes and the legacy Lab V2 PCS reading checked against LittleCMS 2 source (cmstypes.c Type_NamedColor_Read; cmsio1.c _cmsReadInputLUT appends _cmsStageAllocLabV2ToV4 to every named-colour pipeline), read 2026-11-01. ICC.1:2022 text not checked: UNVERIFIED (D5). XYZ-PCS named-colour profiles are refused because LittleCMS applies the Lab V2->V4 stage whatever the PCS.
